sql: SELECT id, status, title FROM article;
SELECT id, status, title, body FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'];
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];

SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR heading CONTAINS 'kill' OR heading CONTAINS 'pull' OR body CONTAINS 'benchmark' OR body CONTAINS 'exit poll';
SELECT id, content, parent FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT in, out FROM covers WHERE out IN (SELECT id FROM topic);
SELECT id, status, published_at FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04' ORDER BY status;
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
